name: B10-0424/2026 – After § 13 – Am 64
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the need for an EU strategy to counter Islamist entryism and the influence of the Muslim Brotherhood network
part_text: 13a. Urges the Member States to implement strict legal mechanisms to ensure that any individual holding refugee status or international protection who actively promotes ideologies contrary to fundamental European values –specifically including the subjugation of women, antisemitism and anti-Christian hatred – faces the immediate revocation of their protection status and the immediate withdrawal of all associated social and economic benefits, as well as an immediate return to their country of origin;
